author: vonderleyen
text:
Back in New York for the @UN General Assembly.

New geopolitical realities. 
New troubled waters. 

But the same urgent priorities for Europe and our partners.

Peace for Ukraine. 
Stability in the Middle East. 
Climate action and a clean energy transition that powers our industries.

The world is changing fast. But cooperation and multilateralism remain our best answer. Proven time and again, especially in difficult times.

A busy week of hard work ahead. 

And I’m looking forward to it.
